title: OCR A/B tick
description: Every 10 seconds, look at the click-logger SIGNAL band and either click UPPER (path A) or LOWER (path B).
notes: Lower priority than minute_clip — deferred while a clip is recording.

actions.description: Snapshot the anchored window so OCR has a fresh frame.
Read the yellow SIGNAL band and parse it as A or B.
Branch on the parsed SIGNAL value.
actions.explain_a: click the UPPER circle on the click logger (preset 'ab choice a')
actions.explain_b: click the LOWER circle on the click logger (preset 'ab choice b')

on_a.message: PATH A action: one left-click on UPPER

on_a.description: Click UPPER via preset ab choice a.

on_b.message: PATH B action: one left-click on LOWER

on_b.description: Click LOWER via preset ab choice b.
